title: The Mobile Wallet On-Time Promise
content:
**Promise.** On a Mobile Wallet tier that carries the on-time promise, Paloma refunds the transfer fee in full, with the fee-refund reason "late delivery", when the credit landed late for a reason on Paloma's or the provider's side.

**When a credit is late.**
- On a tier with a minute promise above 0: when the moment the provider confirmed the credit is more than the promised minutes after the latest release moment.
- On any other tier: when the date of the confirmed credit is after the date available as last disclosed.

The release moment, the credit moment, the date available and the tier are read from the transfer's system record.

**What is not covered.** Lateness caused by the recipient's wallet (a sender-side failure and its retry) or by a request for information answered late is not covered.

**Scope.** The promise covers the transfer fee only, can be claimed from an agent without an error notice, and never stacks with an error-resolution fee refund.

### Boundary cases (hypothetical)

| Tier | Latest release | Credit confirmed | Late |
|---|---|---|---|
| Mobile Wallet Priority (10-minute promise) | 12:00:00 | 12:10:00 | no; not more than 10 minutes |
| Mobile Wallet Priority (10-minute promise) | 12:00:00 | 12:10:01 | yes |
| Mobile Wallet Express (date promise) | date available 2026-05-04 | 2026-05-04 at 23:50 | no |
| Mobile Wallet Express (date promise) | date available 2026-05-04 | 2026-05-05 at 00:05 | yes |

A late credit whose lateness came from a wallet-suspended rejection and the retry that followed it is not covered, whatever the times show.
